text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, they're doing a giveaway
for Umamusume bromides, aren't they?
Time to instantly ReUma—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... How could someone like Digitan
miss info that was re-umatted 1,254 times...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, spreading the word now is kinda awkward, and
I feel so, so awful for the Umamusume-chan...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to... I have to build up some good karma...!
